result.summary: The page is generally well-structured, but the bottom navigation contains a prominent visual rendering artifact. Horizontal content carousels are also visibly clipped at the right edge, though this may be intentional scrolling behavior.

issues.description: A thick dark horizontal line runs across the bottom navigation and overlaps the search icon, making the navigation look broken or incorrectly rendered.
issues.suggestion: Remove the stray line or implement it as a properly positioned tab indicator that does not overlap the navigation icons.

issues.description: The category row and the 'Fastest near you' restaurant carousel are cut off at the right edge, leaving partial pills/cards visible.
issues.suggestion: If these are horizontal carousels, add a clearer scroll affordance or slight right padding; otherwise ensure items are contained within the viewport.
